group1.faq1_q: Do I need to register a credit card to test?
group1.faq1_a: No! The trial is 100% free and we do not require any financial data. You only pay if you decide to continue after the trial period.
group1.faq2_q: Does the system work on mobile?
group1.faq2_a: Yes, NEXT is fully responsive and works perfectly on mobile phones, tablets, and computers.
group1.faq3_a: We have an easy import tool and, in the Pro and Empire plans, our team assists throughout the migration process.
group1.faq4_q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
group1.faq4_a: Absolutely. There is no loyalty or fines. You can cancel your subscription at any time directly through the dashboard.
group1.faq5_a: Yes! We offer support via chat, email, and WhatsApp (for Pro and Empire plans) during business hours.
group1.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
group1.t1_text: We replaced the physical agenda with NEXT and our no-shows dropped 90% in just 4 weeks. Upfront Pix charging saved my monthly revenue.

group1.t2_text: The messaging barrier on WhatsApp is over. Now clients book on their own in the middle of the night and our schedule is full in the morning on autopilot.
group1.t3_text: Commission control was my biggest monthly nightmare. Today NEXT does everything automatically in seconds. I wouldn't trade it for anything.
group1.t4_text: The multiple professionals feature sharing the agenda with individual panels changed the game for our barbershop. Clean and professional visualization.
group1.t5_text: The online booking link is extremely fast. My clients highly praise the ease of booking via mobile in seconds.
group1.t6_text: We increased the average ticket of the barbershop by offering combos through the system. The client sees the combos when booking and ends up choosing them.
group1.t7_text: My clients highly praise the ease of booking. Without needing to download an app, they book in 3 clicks through their own phone browser.
group1.t8_text: Having a complete system with our brand and automatic WhatsApp reminders reduced support time to zero. Extremely fair investment.
group1.t9_text: The cash flow and profit reports gave me clarity on which services have more margin. We increased real revenue by 35%.
group1.t10_text: NEXT runs smoothly on mobile, tablet, and computer. I manage my two units from anywhere in the world from my phone with total security.
group1.t11_text: Automatic reminders drastically reduce no-shows. The client receives a cancellation link if needed, freeing up the slot.
group1.t12_text: Excellent cost-benefit. The system pays for itself on the first day with time savings and reduced client no-shows.
